periods: Inherit research_contract.json route discovery/evaluation boundaries; no 2024+ data. IFCGR inherits OGR, not independent evidence.
evidence: CASE_BLINDED_CONDITIONAL_ON_PRIOR_RESULT_EXPOSURE; all route histories already consumed. No untouched OOS or independent observer claim.
blind_order: temporal quantitative check and error analysis

matching.predeclared_fallback: If fewer than two strict pairs, fill remaining slots with native return >= .02 versus <= -.02 under identical path calipers. Never relax calipers; report shortage.
matching.algorithm: Enumerate valid opposite-outcome pairs; ascending sum of squared caliper-normalized distances; SHA256 tie breaker; greedy unique episode and event cluster across all selected routes. Anonymous order determined by independent SHA256. One decision per episode.
matching.information_limit: Observer knows matched-pair design but not case identities, dates, outcome class, final return, native exit time or reason. Selection by future contrast is not population prevalence sampling.

chart_template.panel_a: Entry-normalized coordinate/raw price OHLC; entry; target known at entry; registered structural anchor. SMV6 rolling40 close anchor. Native exit only FULL-PATH-POSTMORTEM. Eligibility marker is known earliest policy sell session, not future successful execution.
chart_template.panel_b: current return, MAE-so-far, MFE-so-far and giveback-so-far; never final excursions on blind charts
chart_template.panel_c: volume relative to entry-day volume and current volume/prior five held-session mean (min3). Fixed scale; no volume available => NA
chart_template.panel_d: SMV6 price ratio relative to existing frozen 000852.SH daily benchmark, normalized at entry open. Other routes NA: frozen market/industry signal-state aggregates are not a verified cumulative return benchmark.
chart_template.panel_e: SMV6 FINAL_CLOSE_BAR pre_adj_close / PSEUDO_CLOSE_14_57_OPEN pre_adj_open - 1, both VALID and available_at <= decision t. Role/field clarification from frozen callback, before any image view. Stocks NA: existing first-minute execution evidence does not support VWAP or full-session quality. No new minute data downloaded.
chart_template.layout: Five rows; columns are anonymous cases in stable order, identical scales across routes and outcomes. Postmortem adds fixed 0..20 zoom inset for ALL cases; full path retained. Clipped-point counts recorded; never outcome-driven autoscale.
chart_template.blind_payload: Explicit allowlist of prefix chart fields; no symbol, actual date, future or outcome fields. Truncate before serialization. Invalid bars create gaps, no forward fill.
chart_template.ablation_limit: Same observer and same cases in fixed sequence; carryover is unavoidable. Descriptive repeatability check only, no causal information-gain or accuracy inference from confidence.

categories.simple_stop_rescued: fixed10 filled; native return <= -.10; policy advantage > 0
categories.simple_stop_harmed: fixed10 filled; native return >= .05; policy advantage < 0

galleries.sampling: First case closest to category median native return, ties SHA256; second lowest independent SHA256 among remaining episodes. Empty categories remain empty. Blind samples are not preferred. All selections discovery-mature only.
galleries.smv6: No new fixed-stop replay for gallery; existing frozen actual-callback native residuals only. Simple-stop categories NOT_OPENED; severe/deep categories may be empty, no threshold lowering.

motif_budget: At most 2 KEEP_FOR_TEST motifs per route, 1..3 computable representations each. At most 6 distinct new representations globally, <=12 predictors per route including B0. New post-evaluation ideas only NEXT_RESEARCH_HYPOTHESIS.

quantitative_contract.label: Inherited exit_advantage_normalized: next-legal-open liquidation of current inventory versus native hold, fees/execution included. No newly inferred fill rules.
quantitative_contract.models: B0 six existing price-path features; same alpha10 Ridge B0+motif; existing B0+close_location+recovery_3 as price-only augmentation control; B1 eleven existing features as incumbent control. Same-fold rows and event weights. Tree depth2 both sides only >=100 training events, as corroboration, never rescue a failed primary Ridge.
quantitative_contract.splits: Existing annual expanding, event/cluster purged and label availability < training cutoff. Discovery labels mature before evaluation boundary. Fit only on preceding years; no selection from temporal results.
quantitative_contract.incremental_gate: Discovery MSE improvement over both B0 and price-augmentation control; positive top-quintile realized exit advantage over >=20 distinct episodes and >=5 signal dates; improvement remains after removing top five contributing signal dates. Temporal check must repeat all gates without feature/rule changes. Otherwise no robust-state claim and no mechanism exit candidate.
quantitative_contract.missing: Train-only median for models; all-missing representation is unavailable, not evidence. Full representation availability reported. Policy cannot rely on imputed state.
quantitative_contract.account_gate: Only a motif meeting both phases may be considered for a separately frozen <=2 mechanism policy within parent execution contract. Full cash replay then required; ATRDR account quarantine remains. No signal, allocation or live changes in visual stage.
quantitative_contract.visual_case_reuse: Discovery cases are hypothesis-generating, not an independent statistical validation set. Report selected-case overlap; consumed temporal history is also not pristine OOS.
